body:
Add an external NC program simulation runner and command in `crates/app`.
It connects `camcraft-gcode` (#2217) to CamCraft's stock simulation, collision verification, and machine limit checks.

## Scope
- Depend on `camcraft-gcode` in `crates/app/Cargo.toml` and record the crate edge in `docs/decisions/` per `AGENTS.md`.
- Map each `T<n>` number from the NC file to a document tool (`tool_numbers::numbers` in `crates/app/src/tool_numbers.rs`), a `.camtools` file (`crates/app/src/tool_library.rs`), or an explicit `T -> tool` map.
- Return the list of unmapped `T<n>` numbers and refuse simulation when any `T` number lacks cutter geometry.
- Read stock, optional target models, fixtures, WCS origins (`G54`..`G59`), and the mounted `.mch` from the active setup (`crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`, `crates/app/src/setup_wcs.rs`), while allowing caller overrides.
- Transform NC program coordinates into world millimeters (`world = origin + sign * program_mm`), reversing `posting::wcs_context` and `post::invert` (`crates/post/src/post/invert.rs`).
- Run `camcraft_sim::stock_sim::Dexel` and `deviate` against the setup stock and optional target model, refusing setups with no stock by name (`stock_sim::stock_grid`).
- Run region-free verification laws: `verify::solid_hits` against the target model (when present), `bands_vs_fixtures_held`, and `rapids_vs_fixtures_held` (`crates/sim/src/verify/laws.rs`, `solid.rs`).
- Run `machine::judge` travel, feed, and spindle checks (`crates/app/src/machine/mod.rs`), mapping every finding to its 1-based NC line number.
- Build a `PlaySeed` (`crates/app/src/stock_play.rs`) for the parsed sections so UI playback can run it.

Depends on #2217.

Done means: Integration tests in `crates/app/tests/` simulate a 3-axis NC file against stock, model, fixtures, and `.mch`, refuse unmapped tools or missing stock by name, return line-numbered gouge/fixture/travel findings, and construct a working `PlaySeed`.

Part of #2213
